description: Preferred runway modes, owner-supplied 24-10-2026, in priority order (order in this file is the tie-break, 1 is most preferred). 27AD-34D's departures are split by SID in real operations (34 via MNG, NONIX and DOSEL; 27 for all other departures); the pack has no concept of a SID-conditional runway, so both departure runways are listed together. 34A-27AD is the LAHSO (land and hold short) mode: runway 34 is the active runway, 27 the passive one. Its real-world minima (ceiling A045 or higher, visibility 8 km or more, dry surface, no reported windshear) are not yet enforced by the engine — see the enhancement issue. No crosswind limit or capacity figure has been supplied for any mode yet, so they fall back to the pack's default crosswind limit and have no capacity limit.

modes.description: Arrivals 27; departures 34 (via MNG, NONIX, DOSEL) and 27 (all other departures)
LAHSO: arrivals 34 and 27, departures 27. Runway 34 active, 27 passive. Minima not enforced by the engine (see enhancement issue).
